plan.title: Treated vs control muscle DE with outlier sensitivity check
plan.analytical_narrative: The dataset is a small (5 vs 5, unpaired, single-batch) bulk RNA-seq experiment in human muscle tissue with raw Salmon gene-level counts (12000 genes x 10 samples). The data profile flags sample_03 as a clear outlier on both PCA and the sample-distance heatmap. With n=5 per group, one aberrant sample can dominate a standard DESeq2 Wald test, so the plan runs the differential expression contrast twice — once on all 10 samples and once with sample_03 excluded — and compares the two gene lists explicitly rather than silently dropping the sample. This directly answers 'which genes differ' while being honest about how fragile that answer is to the flagged sample. QC (library size, PCA, sample-distance heatmap) is regenerated as a deliverable artifact rather than re-explored, since the outlier call is already established in the profile. Downstream pathway enrichment on the DE result (both with and without the outlier) uses the WikiPathways human gene sets confirmed present in the reference store, contextualizing the transcriptional differences and giving a biological sanity check on whether the outlier-inclusive and outlier-exclusive DE signatures point to similar or divergent processes.
